create_base_evaluator: create a BaseEvaluator instance with intermediate evaluations path and supported prediction formats
run_base_evaluator_call: run the BaseEvaluator __call__ method on a dataset path and split to produce a DatasetEvaluation
build_docling_document_from_doctags: build a DoclingDocument from a DatasetRecordWithPrediction containing doctags string
test_supported_prediction_formats: test the BaseEvaluator supported_prediction_formats method to return allowed prediction format types
save_intermediate_evaluations: save intermediate evaluation results as JSON files using the BaseEvaluator save_intermediate_evalutions method
